text: Hi, ek is 'n pensioenaris en ek het verlede maand my kontrak opgegradeer, maar my maandelikse rekening het skielik R450 meer gewees as wat ek verwag het. Die klerk het gesê dit is 'data buite die bundel', en niemand het my ooit daarvan vertel nie, so kan julle asseblief die bedrag nagaan wanneer julle tyd het?

Sawubona, I upgraded from prepaid to a contract last month and nobody explained that the extra data charges would be billed separately, so my debit order for R1,200 came out higher than I budgeted. I'm on a pension, so please check when convenient why I was charged out of bundle and how I can avoid it going forward.

Molo, my contract went through on the upgrade and now there's a charge of R380 for usage I thought was included, something the consultant called out-of-bundle, and I'm not happy because I'm a pensioner and I must stick to my budget. Ek sal dankbaar wees as julle dit ondersoek en my vertel hoe ek my bundel beter kan bestuur.

hi need to cancel my contract asap i leave for jhb on thursday and cant have them debiting me R899 after i'm gone, pls sort this out before then, i travel every 2 weeks for work so i dont even use the line much anymore

Please stop my airtime contract ASAP, im flying out again next week and I cant keep getting charged for a line I barely use. Its eating into my budget every month and I need it sorted before my next debit order goes through on the 1st, thx

Hey I need to end my contract soon as possible. Im always on the road for work, out of town most weeks, and the monthly fee of R1,050 for a phone i hardly touch is ridiculous. Pls sort it before the 25th, cant have another month taken off my card

Hi, ek is so vies right now. My data bundle finished on Sunday night but my phone still charged me R349 out of my airtime for data I never asked for. I'm a student, I need to submit my assignment tonight and I can't even load my documents. Please fix this urgently, I need my money back today.

Sharp sharp, I need help. My bundle was finished and somehow I'm being billed per MB at the out-of-bundle rate, almost R500 gone from my airtime this week alone. I'm busy with exams and I'm literally stuck without data for my research. Please stop this and refund me asap, ngiyabonga.

Eish, this is serious. I didn't switch on any out-of-bundle setting, yet my account was debited R1,200 for data usage in the last two days. As a student on a tight budget this is wrena, I can't afford it. Please reverse the charges and make sure it doesn't happen again tonight, it's urgent.
I've been charged twice for my data bundle this month, R499 gone twice, and I'm a student who can't afford this, so fix it soon.
Why is my account showing two debit orders of R350 for the same airtime package? Sort this out soon before I lose more money.
Your system took my monthly contract payment twice this week and I'm a broke student, so refund the extra R275 soon or I'm going to complain further!

My mother is 74 and only uses her phone for calls to the clinic. Last night a debit order of R1,450 went off her account for a contract she never signed. We went into the shop last year and they said she would stay on her prepaid airtime. Please stop this today, she cannot afford it and I need someone to call us back urgently.

I am a pensioner and I was told my upgrade from prepaid to a contract would not cost me anything extra. This morning I saw a new monthly charge of R899 on my bank statement that I did not agree to, and someone has also been ringing me from an unknown number asking for my ID details. I need this checked urgently and the charges reversed before the next debit order runs.

I got a message saying my prepaid line had been moved onto a contract and that I owed R2,100 for a phone I never received. I have not signed anything and I never went back to any shop to upgrade. Somebody must be using my details. I am on a pension and cannot pay this. Please block whatever is happening and call me as a matter of urgency.
I am a frequent traveller and was charged R4,850 in international roaming fees on my last trip to Namibia, despite having no roaming bundle active, and I require this amount reversed urgently.

Please urgently review the R3,200 roaming charges on my latest invoice from a recent business trip abroad, as I was never notified of any data use exceeding my expectations and need this resolved immediately.

As a regular international traveller, I urgently request an explanation and reversal of the R2,760 costs billed to my account for data and calls made while overseas, which I was not warned about before departure.

I am a pensioner and I agreed to move my prepaid line onto a contract last week, but the upgrade has left my account in a mess and I cannot make a call to my doctor today. Please fix this urgently because I have been without a working line since yesterday morning.

My prepaid number was switched to a contract plan on Monday and now I have no airtime and no service at all, even though I only signed because the consultant said it would be simpler. I live alone and need this sorted out today, so please have someone phone me back as soon as possible.

After the change from prepaid to contract, my line stopped working and I was still charged a R1,200 deposit that I did not expect on my pension income. This is urgent because I cannot reach my family or my clinic, so please reverse the charge and restore my service today.

I was charged R1,800 in international roaming fees while I was in Zimbabwe last week and nobody warned me before it happened. I need this reversed today because my exam fees are due tomorrow and I can't afford to lose that money.

My data bundle ran out abroad in Botswana and the network kept billing me per megabyte at a rate I never agreed to, which is now over R2,000 on my statement. Please stop these charges immediately and refund what I've been overcharged, as I'm a student with no spare cash this month.

I'm back from a study trip in Namibia and my latest bill shows international call and data charges of almost R1,500 that I didn't authorise. This needs to be sorted urgently because the payment is due in two days and I'll be blocked from my account if it isn't resolved.
My daughter is stuck overseas on her exchange and I was charged R3,400 for calls to her last night, so please reverse this now and stop the roaming charges before I lose my mind, asseblief!
Ek is die ouer wat betaal, and my son in London could not call home for three days, yet the bill still shows R2,850 in international charges, so fix this urgently, ngiyacela.
Hayi, my teen is abroad and the data and call costs on my account jumped to R4,100 overnight with no warning, so I need someone to stop it immediately and explain what happened.
Our office manager here is fuming because the PBX lines racked up R3,400 in charges while we were nowhere near the network, so sort this out before our next debit order hits.
Why is our business account showing international call charges from a country none of our staff have visited, and I need this reversed and explained before month end.
Every time one of our handsets is switched on abroad we get billed through the nose, and if this isn't fixed soon I'm moving our whole office contract elsewhere.

Good day, my mamma in Durban is very sick and I need to call her hospital in Pietermaritzburg tonight, but since my upgrade to the new contract my international calls keep failing and it is charging me R45 per minute on my debit order anyway. I am a pensioner, I cannot afford this, please fix it urgently, ek is baie bekommerd, sawubona.

Hello, I am calling again because I have tried four times to phone my son in Canada about his ouma's funeral arrangements and the call will not go through. Since I moved from prepaid to the contract last week, I now see R1,200 more on my account for international airtime I never used. This is critical for me, asseblief help me before tomorrow, ngiyabonga.

Morning, I am a pensioner and my daughter in Namibia is expecting her baby any day now, I must be able to speak to her. Ever since the upgrade from my prepaid to this contract the international line drops and I was billed R800 for calls that did not connect. Dis dringend, please sort this out today, baie dankie.

Our business account with your company was charged twice for the same monthly contract period, with two debit orders of R1,850 each leaving our account on the 1st. We need the duplicate amount of R1,850 reversed immediately, as this payment has left our shop's operating account short before payroll.

I am writing to report that my shop's airtime and line rental were billed twice this month, and the same R2,300 debit order was processed on both the 3rd and the 5th. This is a critical matter for my business, so please refund the duplicate R2,300 urgently and confirm in writing when it has been done.

The statement for my small shop shows that the monthly service fee of R950 has been charged to my account twice in the same billing cycle. Given how tight our cash flow is this month, I request that the second charge be reversed without delay and that you confirm the correction to me today.
My shop's internet has been dead since this morning and I'm losing customers by the minute, fix it now or I'm cancelling and reporting this nonsense!
Your network cut my card machine off in the middle of the lunch rush again and I've lost sales worth R3,000 today, sort this out immediately!
I've phoned your call centre four times and nobody has helped me get my shop's line back, this is unacceptable and I want someone to fix it right now!
someone used my account to buy R3500 airtime and my debit order keeps going out, pls help asap i didnt do this
Hi my shop line got charged for things i never ordered, R1,800 gone from my acount, need someone to check it soon plz
Ther is a contract on my name i never signed and they debited R950 from my shop acount, fix this today pls
Ek reis elke week tussen Joburg en Durban vir werk, en my data het vandag heeljaar weer nie gewerk by OR Tambo nie, so ek is stuck sonder enige internet vir my kliënte, ek need help nou-nou.
I'm on the road every week and sizobona, my line has been dead since I landed in Cape Town this morning, and I've got a client call in an hour, please sort this out now.
Ngihamba njalo emsebenzini phakathi kwe-Polokwane ne-Gqeberha, and now my phone is completely off-network at the airport with no SIM services, ngicela usizo masinyane, I'm missing my flight check-in.

My shop's data ran out in the middle of the day and now I'm being charged R1,200 for out-of-bundle usage I never agreed to, and I need this reversed today before my debit order goes through. Nobody warned me my bundle had finished and I'm furious that I'm paying for it.

I have a small shop and your network billed me R850 in out-of-bundle charges overnight while I was closed, which I never authorised. Fix this urgently because the amount is coming off my account tomorrow and I am done being charged for services I didn't ask for.

Your system kept my business line running past my bundle and now there's a R1,400 charge on my statement that I did not agree to, and I want it stopped immediately. I've been a customer for years and this is how you treat small business owners, so sort it out today.

As office manager at our Johannesburg branch, I must formally report that our telecom account has been charged twice for the same billing cycle this month, with two debit orders of R4,850 each appearing on our statement for the PBX service. This is an urgent matter affecting our cash flow, and I request an immediate reversal of the duplicate charge and written confirmation of the corrected balance before the next debit run.

I am writing on behalf of our company, which operates a PBX system across two offices, to escalate a critical billing error. Our latest invoice reflects the monthly PBX line rental being debited a second time, resulting in an overcharge of R3,120 that was not authorised under our contract. Please treat this as urgent, refund the duplicate amount to our account, and confirm in writing that no further duplicate debits will be processed.

Kindly note that the office I manage has identified a serious discrepancy on our telecom statement: the PBX maintenance and line fees were billed twice within the same month, totalling R2,740 in excess charges. Given the risk of further unauthorised deductions, I require this matter to be resolved as a priority, the duplicate amount credited back, and a formal explanation of how the error occurred.

I travel to Namibia and Botswana for work about twice a month, and every time I come back there is a roaming charge on my account that I did not expect. Could you please explain these charges and check whether my roaming bundle was applied correctly?

Every time I return from a work trip abroad, my bill shows data and call charges I was not warned about before I left. Please look into why my international add-on did not cover my usage and let me know what I can do about it.

As someone who is often away on business in Zimbabwe and Mozambique, I expected my roaming package to cover my data, but I was billed extra on my last statement. Can you review the roaming usage on my line and tell me how to avoid this on my next trip?
hey pls help urgent im in durban for exam and my data roaming charged me R1 200 on my contract and i never even turned it on
URGENT!! i got back from lesotho and my phone billed me like R3,400 in data i didnt use, need this sorted before my exam tmrw
my student account shows R2 800 roaming charges from a trip i did last week, i was just on wifi the whole time pls fix asap i cant pay this

Hi i upgraded from prepaid to a contrct last week and now they keep debiting my acount R899 every month and i never agreed to it. I need this cancelled asap before next debit order date pls help, im a pensioner on fixed income.

I was told by the shop that the upgrade to contract would be cancelled if i didnt like it but now my bank shows a new R1,050 debit and nobody answers the phone. Please stop it soon as my pension only comes on the 1st and i cant afford this.

Good day, i went from prepaid to a contract on the 3rd and its been nothing but trouble, they want R750 a month and i just want out of it before the next billing run. Kindly sort the cancellation urgently as im retired and cant carry these charges.

My shop's internet has been down for four days and I've been charged a full R1,200 debit order this month anyway. Nobody on your helpline will tell me when it's getting fixed, and I'm sick of paying for a service I can't use.

I'm furious that my card machine line has been dead since Monday while you keep taking my monthly contract payment without fail. Every time I phone in I get a different story and no one follows up, so I want this sorted out properly.

Your fibre at my shop in the township has been unreliable for a week and I've lost customers because of it, yet my account still shows the full package fee. I expect a proper explanation and a credit on my next statement, not another useless call centre script.

Hi, my contract bill came out twice this month, so the same R699 was taken from my account on the 1st and again on the 3rd, and now I'm sitting with no money for my rent. Please fix this today, ek kan nie wag nie, I'm a student and this is urgent.

Ek het vandag met my bank-statement gesien dat my airtime-debiet twee keer uitgegaan het, so R350 is now gone twice and my account is in the red. Asseblief sort dit nou dadelik, I'm a student and I can't afford this, it's urgent.

Yoh, something is wrong, sawubona, because my debit order for my data bundle hit my account two times this month, R499 each time, and now I'm short for my textbooks. Please reverse the extra one as a matter of urgency, ngiyabonga, I really need it back now.

My daughter's line was charged R450 for data she never meant to use, and the account now shows she's out of bundle with no warning. I need someone to stop these charges today before the next debit order goes through.

I got an SMS saying my son has been billed for extra data at R2 per MB and he's barely been online this month. Please halt the charges immediately, because I can't afford another surprise amount coming off my account this week.

The bill for my teenager's contract shows over R1,200 in out-of-bundle usage that we never agreed to, and it's being taken on the 25th. This needs to be fixed urgently, so please reverse it and put a hold on any further charges.
My data ran out halfway through the month and now I'm being charged R1,200 for extra usage I never agreed to, and I want it sorted before my next debit order goes through.
I'm furious that my shop's line got billed out-of-bundle rates overnight, so fix this before the next debit order hits my account on Friday!
Why am I paying per megabyte on my business line when my package said unlimited, and I need this reversed before the next billing run this week.
I've been charged R850 for data I never used and my exam portal is locked out right now, fix this today or I'm going to the ombudsman.
My student contract was switched to a higher package without me agreeing and now I can't even submit my assignment online, sort this out immediately!
Your system took my debit order twice this month, I'm a student with no money and I need my account reactivated before my exams tomorrow!

Good day. I am a pensioner and recently agreed to move my prepaid line over to a contract. Since the switch, the monthly amount taken from my account does not match what the consultant explained to me in the shop, and I would appreciate it if someone could review the arrangement and contact me within the next few days so that this can be corrected before my next debit order runs.

To whom it may concern. After my prepaid number was converted to a contract last month, I was given a different package than the one I signed for, and I have been charged accordingly. As a retiree on a fixed income, I respectfully request that this be looked into soon and that I be advised in writing of the correct terms, as I would like to avoid any further deductions.

Dear Sir or Madam, I wish to lodge a formal concern regarding the upgrade of my account from prepaid to contract. I was assured that my airtime allowance would remain the same, yet my statement shows otherwise. Kindly have the matter attended to at your earliest convenience, as I am a pensioner and cannot absorb an unexpected monthly cost.
my sister is in hospital in durban and i cant call her from overseas roaming, ive been charged R3400 already and nothing works, fix this now pls. i need to talk to her today its urgent

Im a student studying in london and my data/calls to home keep cutting out and i got hit with R2,850 on my last statement for calls i never made. my exam results come out tomorrow and i need to reach my family asap, sort this out

someone from my res in cape town is missing and my parents cant reach me on the number i use abroad, the roaming charges are R1,900 and the line keeps dropping. please urgently help me get this working before i lose my mind

hey so i travel for work almost every 2 weeks and my data bundle keeps running out the second i land in joburg or durban, i got charged R450 for a roaming bundle i didnt even activate, pls look into it when u can not urgent just annoying me alot

Im always on the road for work and every time i get back from cape town the account shows extra charges i dont understand, last month it was R289 and nobdy has explained it to me, can someone call me back sometime this week when they have time thx

Frequent flyer here, been travelling nonstop and my sim keeps dropping signal at the airport and then the debit order for my contract still goes out even tho i cancelled the add on in March, just want it sorted whenever, not a big rush but its getting old

Eish, our PBX is charging us roaming rates on every call we make from the Durban branch and now the bill is R38,500 for one month, please fix this urgently before the directors see it. Ons kan nie so voortgaan nie.

Our office phones are racking up international roaming charges through the PBX every time the team is on the road, and the latest statement shows R52,000 in roaming alone, this needs sorting today or we are going to suspend the account. Asseblief, dringend.

The switchboard keeps routing our staff calls over roaming when they are in Joburg for meetings, and we have been billed R14,800 extra this cycle without any warning. Sort it out now, ek is baie kwaad and the admin team is stuck.

Good day. I am a pensioner and I upgraded my line from prepaid to a contract last month. My debit order has now gone through twice for the same R1,200 on the same date, and my account is short for my medication. Please urgently reverse the duplicate payment and confirm in writing that it will not happen again.

To whom it may concern, I recently moved my number from prepaid to a monthly contract as a pensioner. Since the change, my bank statement shows two identical contract charges of R899 taken on one day. This is a serious problem for my budget, so I request an immediate correction and a refund of the extra amount.

I am writing as a retired person who switched from a prepaid plan to a contract account last month. Two debits of R1,050 were taken from my account for the same billing cycle, leaving me unable to cover essentials this week. I urgently ask that the duplicate charge be refunded without delay and that my account be checked for further errors.

hi my son has a line on our contract and there is a debit order of R1,099 thats not ours, i never signed up for any extra data bundle or the premium sms thing. dont know who did it or how, can someone look into it when u get a chance, not urgent but i want it sorted this month

Good day, I pay the account for my daughter's phone and I noticed three airtime top ups of R200 each on the 3rd and 5th that we did not make. She says she didnt do it either. Please check if somebody got into the account or the sim was swapped, and let me know what you find, no rush but please dont ignore it

Hello, my teenager's cellphone is on my account and I see a subscription charge R149 monthly for some content service i never asked for. Looks suspicious to me. Pls check who added it and remove it and refund what was taken. Routine matter but i need answer by end of month thanks

My daughter is 15 and I'm the one paying for her line. Last night I got an SMS saying she's been charged R2,400 for data I never gave her, and it's coming off my debit order on the 1st. I need someone to stop this today, before the money leaves my account, and tell me exactly what she used and where it came from.

I pay the monthly contract for my son who is 16. This morning I saw a charge of R1,850 on my statement for extra usage that was not in his package at all, and the account shows he kept going after the limit warning. Please block any further charges now and reverse this amount, because I cannot afford it this month.

Our account is in my name for my 14-year-old's phone. Overnight, the data usage went far past what we pay for and I've been billed about R3,100 in extras. I have not agreed to any add-on and I want the excess cancelled and the usage switched off on her line immediately, since it is still running.
Since moving from prepaid to a contract, I was charged R2,350 for data I used while visiting Namibia on my last trip, and I need this billing error corrected before my next statement is due.
As a pensioner who recently switched to a contract, I request that the roaming charges of R1,870 that appeared on my account after my trip to Mozambique be reviewed and reversed soon.

I wish to lodge a formal complaint that my new contract account was billed for international calls made while abroad, amounting to R3,100, and I ask that this be addressed promptly before the debit order is processed.

My son's line racked up R3,400 in international roaming charges while he was on a school trip in Zimbabwe, and nobody warned me before it happened. I am furious that I'm expected to pay this when I never agreed to any of it.

I pay the debit order on my daughter's contract every month and last month it jumped by almost R2,800 because of calls to the UK she made from her phone. Explain to me why an international bundle wasn't put on her account without my consent, because this is outrageous.

Every time my teenager calls family overseas the charges come out of my account at ridiculous rates, and this month it came to R1,900 with no warning from anyone. I want this sorted out and a proper explanation for why I was billed like this, because I am very angry.

Dear Support Team, I am a full-time student and I would like to formally request the termination of my airtime contract with effect from the end of this billing cycle. Kindly confirm in writing once the cancellation has been processed and advise whether any early termination fee applies, as I am not currently in a position to pay one. I would appreciate your response at your earliest convenience.

To whom it may concern, I write as a registered student to give notice that I wish to end my current contract with your company. Please provide written confirmation of the termination date and ensure that no further debit orders are taken from my bank account after that date. I would be grateful for a clear statement of any outstanding balance I need to settle.

Good day, I am currently studying full time and no longer require the service on my account. I kindly ask that you close the contract at the next available opportunity and send me a reference number for the request. Please also confirm that my monthly debit order of R450 will stop once the account is closed. Thank you for your assistance in this matter.

I was charged R1,450 in out-of-bundle data fees on my business line this month, even though my account shows I still had a full data bundle active. This needs to be reversed immediately, as the unexpected debit has left my shop unable to cover its supplier payments.

My latest statement reflects roughly R1,200 in data charges billed after my bundle was supposedly exhausted, which I was never notified about and did not authorise. Please escalate this urgently and halt any further deductions, because my card is now being declined for my store's stock orders.

Without any warning, my shop's line was billed for excess data usage of R980 this cycle, despite my understanding that I was on an uncapped package. I require an immediate investigation and a credit to my account, as this unexpected charge has put my monthly debit order at risk of bouncing.
My son's line was charged twice this month, once on the 1st and again on the 3rd, so R499 came off my account twice. Please sort this out soon because I can't afford the extra money.
I'm paying for my daughter's contract and the debit order went through two times this month for the same amount. Can you reverse the second deduction soon, as it's leaving me short for groceries.
The airtime top-up plan for my teenager was billed twice on my card last week, and I've now seen two R349 charges on my statement. I need one of them refunded soon, please.

Hallo, ek is al drie maande in en uit Namibië vir werk en my rekening is weer dubbel gehef. Daar is twee debit orders van R899 elk op dieselfde dag, en my roaming bundel het ook twee keer afgeskryf. Ek het vandag al twee keer gebel en niemand kan vir my sê hoekom nie. Asseblief, ek need hierdie reg gesit word voor my volgende debit order uitgaan, want ek kan nie hierdie geld missen nie.

Sawubona, I travel between Durban and Maputo every second week for work, and this month I was charged twice for the same data add-on, R450 each time, on the same statement. I've been on hold for ages already and the agent just keeps saying she'll log it. Please can someone sort this out soon, because the next debit order is due on the 25th and I can't have my account short again.

Morning. Ek is 'n frequent flyer for work so I'm mostly on the road and I only check my account when I'm back home. Now I see the same airtime top-up was taken twice, R200 twice, plus my monthly contract amount came through double as well. Ek wil graag weet wie gaan my die R1,200 terugbetaal en hoe lank dit gaan neem. Kan julle asseblief dit soon regstel, baie dankie.

My daughter's line has been running up charges I never authorised. Last night there was R1,850 taken from my debit order account for premium SMS subscriptions I have never signed up for, and the bill shows calls to numbers I don't recognise overseas. She's 16 and doesn't have access to anything like that. Please freeze the line and reverse these amounts today, because my bank says the debit order can only be disputed through you.

I pay the monthly contract for my son who is fifteen, and this month the invoice is almost R3,400 higher than normal. Someone has added a roaming package and a bunch of subscription services to his account that neither of us asked for. He's reported that his phone was acting strange and he got a SIM swap message he didn't request. I need someone to block whatever is happening on this account right now and tell me what you are doing about the charges.

Something is seriously wrong with the airtime on my teenage daughter's account. I checked the statement this morning and there are over R2,000 in once-off purchases and transfers I did not make, and she says she never gave anyone her PIN. The debit order went through before I could stop it. Please suspend the account immediately, cancel any new SIM or port requests, and refund the money. I am not paying for this.

Hi team, ons PBX het die afgelope week begin om international calls na ons Botswana kantoor te drop halfpad deur die gesprek. Ons kliënte sit sonder antwoord en dit raak erg. Kan julle asseblief hierna kyk voor die einde van hierdie week? Ons betaal al maande vir die lyne en ek wil nie elke Friday R1,200 se airtime vir niks spandeer nie. Dankie, office manager.

Morning. Since Monday our office PBX keeps cutting out on outbound calls to Namibia and the UK, usually after about two minutes. Sales is losing leads and the staff are getting frustrated, sharp sharp. Please can someone look at the trunk settings or call me back soon, ngiyabonga. We are on the business contract and I need this sorted before month end.

Good day. Our switchboard is giving us problems with international calls again. Calls to Germany and Zimbabwe are dropping, and when clients call back the line just rings without any sound. Ek weet nie meer wat om te doen nie. Please escalate this soon, we cannot have our overseas suppliers thinking we are unreachable. Thanks, office manager.

Hallo, my seun se contract moet nou gekanselleer word, hy gebruik die lyn skaars meer en ek betaal steeds R499 elke maand via debit order. Kan julle asseblief die debit order stop en bevestig dit vir my per SMS?

Sawubona, I'm paying for my dochter's airtime and contract, but she's at varsity now and never uses the line anymore. Please cancel the account at the end of this month so I stop getting charged R650 every month, and send me a reference number.

Goeie dag, ek wil graag my tiener se kontrak beëindig want die foon lê net in die kas en ek sien elke maand dieselfde bedrag op my rekening. Asseblief help my om die diens te stop en laat weet my wanneer die laaste faktuur uitgaan.

Our office PBX line has been running up charges we never agreed to. This month's account shows R14,350 in calls outside our package, and nobody here has been told we'd be billed for that. We need someone to explain it today, because our accounts team is threatening to cut our trunk lines if this goes unresolved.

I'm the office manager here and I am furious. Our switchboard is being billed at out-of-package rates for calls we had no warning about, and the invoice now sits at R9,870 above what we budgeted. Nobody on your side has picked up the phone to tell us why. Fix this immediately or we are moving our business lines elsewhere.

Every month we pay for a bundle that is supposed to cover our PBX, and yet we've been hit with R22,400 in extra charges on the latest statement. This is unacceptable and it is critical for us right now, since the overage is blocking our payroll budget. I want a senior person to call me back today and reverse these charges.
omg someone used my sim and bought R1500 airtime on my account i didnt do it, need this stopped NOW i have no money for food
Somebody has taken over my line, got debit orders hitting my card for stuff i never signed up for, sort this out urgently pls im a student and broke
my number is doing things i dont do, got charged R2,300 for a contract i never agreed to and i cant get through to anyone help asap

My son's phone was still billing data while he was in Mozambique for a school trip, and now there's a R4,850 charge on our account that nobody warned us about. I need this reversed today, he's stranded with no way to reach us and I'm furious that your system let this happen.
